name: factory
description: A control room for many Claude Desktop sessions across many projects: a shared heartbeat, a factory-floor pane, a needs-you queue with one batched notification, a per-project color tint, a collision radar, and Home: a briefing of what every session did while you were away.

hibernate.title: Open Home after you've been away
hibernate.description: Minutes with no typing, prompts or presses in any session before Factory marks you away and opens Home in every session. Off: Home never opens by itself (open it with /home).
